identity_policy: Complete-link XY clustering maximum 1m diameter, class family compatible; same-frame disjoint boxes prevent merge; at least 2 independent frames and an accepted bbox required for stable location. Weak views attach only through unique reprojection into their box. These are inferred identities, not manually verified physical IDs.
condition_policy: At least one clear serviceable observation plus no conflicting clear defect supports object-level visible serviceability; uncertain images do not negate that. Propagation requires multiframe-supported identity.
